description: M1 bench S5: a shield wall of 10 holds its ground while an enemy line of 10 charges its left half and a column of 8 its right. Without combat (M3) there is no melee lock: the wall weighs its hold weight against each attacker, and marching men can work their way round and through it (left for M3). Watch its integrity: how far its men are pushed off their slots.
